Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.component

Class Transforms

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.component.Transforms
public final class Transforms extends Object
The hand transforms named in codegen/model/transforms.json: what no inferred rule explains (each entry there says why). Method names are the camelCase of the transform names; the generator checks every name in transforms.json against the public static methods here. The generated encoders call Transforms.name(ctx, node, owner) with the node the owner writes to and the record that holds the transformed field (the component itself for a component level transform); overloads per owner type.

  • Method Details

    • collisionBoxes

      public static void collisionBoxes(@NonNull WireContext ctx, @NonNull WireNode out, @NonNull CollisionBox c)
      minecraft:collision_box as a list of boxes: enabled and per box min/max in 0..16 block space. BDS from protocol 2225 (26.60; captures of 1.26.63.1) mirrors x: minX = 8 - origin.x - size.x, maxX = 8 - origin.x; y is origin.y to origin.y + size.y, z 8 + origin.z to that plus size.z. Earlier protocols: collisionBoxesUnmirrored(org.geysermc.paletter.internal.component.WireContext, org.geysermc.paletter.internal.component.WireNode, org.geysermc.paletter.block.component.CollisionBox). The boolean form is written by the generated rules.
